body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記貢伯什·久拉生於1886年。Deák書評載，他生於托爾瑙縣、以德裔居民為主的小村莫爾加（Murga），1912年入維也納君主國最負盛名的軍官學校；1919年1月，他在新右翼支持者協助下取得全國國防聯盟（MOVE）的主席職位。Tóth Tibor載，他1920年以小農黨議席進入國會，其後在統一黨（Egységes Párt）擔任副主席；Deák則載，到1923年他被迫轉入反對陣營。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives 1886 as Gyula Gömbös's year of birth. George Deák's review says he was born in the small, mostly ethnic German village of Murga in Tolna county, and that in 1912 he was admitted to the Monarchy's most prestigious officer training school in Vienna. In January 1919 his new rightist adherents helped him gain the presidency of the Hungarian National Defense League (MOVE). Tibor Tóth writes that he entered parliament in 1920 on a Smallholders' Party mandate and later served as vice-president of the Unity Party (Egységes Párt), while Deák says that by 1923 he felt compelled to go into opposition.

heading.zh-Hant: 種族保衛黨與出任國防部長
heading.en: The Race Protector Party and the defence ministry

body.zh-Hant: Deák書評載，1924年貢伯什成為匈牙利民族獨立（種族保衛）黨的領袖。Tóth Tibor載，他與Bajcsy-Zsilinszky Endre、Eckhardt Tibor等人退出執政黨並另組新黨，1928年他將該黨解散，回到執政黨。Pritz Pál也載他1928年請求重返貝特倫的黨。Deák書評載，1929年他出任國防部長。
body.en: George Deák's review says that in 1924 Gömbös became leader of the Hungarian National Independence (Race Protector) Party. Tibor Tóth writes that he left the governing party together with Endre Bajcsy-Zsilinszky, Tibor Eckhardt and others and founded a new party, which he dissolved in 1928 before returning to the governing party. Pál Pritz likewise notes that in 1928 he asked to be taken back into Bethlen's party. Deák adds that in 1929 Gömbös became minister of defense.

body.zh-Hant: Deák書評載，1932年霍爾蒂任命貢伯什為首相；Pritz Pál載他1932年在很大程度上出於貝特倫的意願成為首相，並載他1932年11月以政府首腦身分首次赴羅馬。Deák書評載，他是國民統一黨（NEP）的領袖，該黨雖有近兩百萬登記黨員，但地方上投入有限；他於1936年10月去世。德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他為匈牙利政治家、1932至1936年任首相，並記他卒於慕尼黑。
body.en: George Deák's review says that in 1932 Horthy appointed Gömbös prime minister; Pál Pritz adds that he became prime minister in 1932 largely by Bethlen's will and that, as head of government, he travelled to Rome for the first time in November 1932. Deák says he led the Party of National Unity (NEP), which had nearly two million registered members who were not highly committed locally, and that he died in October 1936. The German National Library authority record describes him as a Hungarian politician and prime minister in 1932-1936 and gives Munich as his place of death.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記帕布羅·阿羅塞梅納生於1836年11月24日、卒於1920年8月29日，職業含政治家、記者與律師。Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture 的條目載，他曾任檢察長，1875與1885年任巴拿馬主權邦總統，兩度被哥倫比亞軍隊推翻，並在1880年當選哥倫比亞的第二副總統。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Pablo Arosemena's birth as 24 November 1836 and death as 29 August 1920, and lists his occupations as politician, journalist and lawyer. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says he was attorney general and president of the Sovereign State of Panama in 1875 and 1885, on both occasions overthrown by the Colombian army, and that in 1880 he was elected second vice president to the Colombian presidency.

body.zh-Hant: 該條目載，他自1910年9月至1912年10月任巴拿馬總統，由國民議會指派，完成何塞·多明戈·德·奧瓦爾迪亞（José Domingo de Obaldía）去世後的任期，並接替在奧瓦爾迪亞死後暫時代理總統的卡洛斯·安東尼奧·門多薩（Carlos Antonio Mendoza）。該條目另稱他是19世紀古典自由主義的熱情擁護者。
body.en: The entry says he served as Panama's president from September 1910 to October 1912, appointed by the National Assembly to finish the term of José Domingo de Obaldía after Obaldía's death, and that he succeeded Carlos Antonio Mendoza, who had temporarily assumed the presidency. The entry also calls him an ardent supporter of classical nineteenth-century liberalism.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記埃德蒙·舒爾特斯生於1868年3月2日。歷史辭典（HLS）載，他讀亞勞州立中學，先後在斯特拉斯堡、慕尼黑、萊比錫、伯爾尼與巴黎修法學，取得律師資格，1891年在布魯格開設律師事務所。他自1893至1912年代表自由民主黨（FDP）在亞勞州大議會，1897至1898年任議長；1905年在亞勞州首次人民直選中進入聯邦院（Ständerat），任至1912年。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives 2 March 1868 as Edmund Schulthess's birth date. The Historical Dictionary of Switzerland says he attended the cantonal school in Aarau, studied law in Strasbourg, Munich, Leipzig, Bern and Paris, qualified as an advocate, and opened a law practice in Brugg in 1891. From 1893 to 1912 he represented the FDP in the Aargau Grand Council, serving as its president in 1897-98. In 1905, in the first popular election in Aargau, he entered the Council of States (Ständerat), where he sat until 1912.

body.zh-Hant: HLS載，舒爾特斯在聯邦委員多伊歇爾（Adolf Deucher）去世後，於1912年7月17日當選聯邦委員，主持商業、工業與農業部，1915年由該部分出的經濟部（Volkswirtschaftsdepartement）也由他領導，共23年；他在1917、1921、1928與1933年任聯邦主席。亞勞州檔案館藏有日期為1912年9月23日、題為聯邦委員舒爾特斯辭去大議會議員的卷宗。HLS又載，1924年的延長工時至54小時方案、1926年穀物專賣與1931年老年保險方案他都未能通過；他主張法郎貶值，此事至1936年才實施。1935年他因倦於任事並受氣喘所苦而辭職。
body.en: The Historical Dictionary of Switzerland says that after the death of Federal Councillor Adolf Deucher, Schulthess was elected to the Federal Council on 17 July 1912. He headed the department of trade, industry and agriculture and, from 1915, the economics department that emerged from it, for 23 years, and was Federal President in 1917, 1921, 1928 and 1933. The Aargau State Archive holds a dossier dated 23 September 1912 titled as the Federal Councillor's resignation as Grand Councillor. The same dictionary records that he did not carry the 1924 extension of working hours to 54 hours, the 1926 grain monopoly or a 1931 old-age insurance bill, and that he favoured a devaluation of the franc, which was implemented only in 1936. Tired of office and plagued by asthma, he resigned in 1935.

body.zh-Hant: HLS載，他辭職後聯邦委員會選他為首任聯邦銀行委員會（Eidg. Bankenkommission）主席，任至1943年。HLS稱他是重視解決問題的務實者，他在經濟政策最困難時期的表現，於離任後獲各黨派承認。德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他為瑞士聯邦委員會成員（FDP），並記他卒於1944年4月22日。
body.en: The Historical Dictionary of Switzerland says the Federal Council chose him, after his resignation, as the first president of the Federal Banking Commission, a function he held until 1943. It calls him a solution-oriented pragmatist and says his performance in the most difficult times for economic policy was recognised across the parties after he left office. The German National Library authority record describes him as a member of the Swiss Federal Council (FDP) and gives 22 April 1944 as his death date.
